title: Audio joins chat completions
summary:
Chat gained audio support, fast text models changed, and model access and pricing now follow one set of rules.

Chat completion requests gained OpenAI-compatible audio input and output fields. Messages can include base64 audio in wav, mp3, flac, opus, or pcm16 format, and requests can specify text or audio output with a voice and format.

`openai-fast` now uses GPT-5 Nano. The new `mistral-fast` option provides text-only Llama 3.1 8B with tool support, also available as `llama-3.1-8b` and `llama-fast`. Meanwhile, `mistral-small` now points to Mistral Small 3.2.

The pricing section gained a “Vote on next models” button linking to the community voting issue.

daily.title: Audio in chat completions
daily.text: Send base64 audio in chat messages and request text or audio output with a chosen voice and format. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

daily.title: GPT-5 Nano for openai-fast
daily.text: `openai-fast` now uses GPT-5 Nano instead of GPT-4.1 Nano. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=openai-fast).

daily.title: Llama joins the fast options
daily.text: Use `mistral-fast` for text-only Llama 3.1 8B with tool support. It also answers to `llama-3.1-8b` and `llama-fast`. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=mistral-fast).

daily.title: Mistral Small 3.2
daily.text: `mistral-small` now points to Mistral Small 3.2. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=mistral-small).

daily.title: Vote on next models
daily.text: A button beside the pricing tables now takes you to community voting for future models.
